spawn.name: A Quiet Alley
spawn.description: The air here is thick with the scent of mildew and damp stone. A chill clings to your coat despite the heat radiating from the nearby ledger-filled stalls of the Market Street merchants. The sound of coins clinking and haggling fades into the silence beyond the broken door to the east, where a sliver of light bleeds through cracks in the warped wood framing it.  The shadows here are deep, punctuated only by the occasional flicker of lamplight that dances along the grime-coated cobblestones. To the west, the Market hums with a cacophony of voices and bartering cries.

broken_door.name: Broken Door
broken_door.description: Skittering sounds can be heard from behind the door.

ledgerfall_market.name: Ledgerfall Market
ledgerfall_market.description: To the West you see a bustling market place.
